english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for ordinary spoken “maybe,” including both possibility and a neutral noncommittal reply.

exampleSentences.english: Maybe he won't go to work today.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ho2 nang4 keoi5 gam1 jat6 m4 faan1 gung1

english.note: Use this when you want to emphasize possibility or uncertainty, especially before 會 or a verb.

exampleSentences.jyutping: ho2 nang4 keoi5 wui5 ci4 dou3

english.note: This is the neutral, all-purpose choice for saying that something may be true or may happen.

exampleSentences.jyutping: ho2 nang4 ting1 jat6 wui5 lok6 jyu5

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something may happen or may have a given result.

exampleSentences.english: This decision could potentially affect the whole plan.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢個決定可能會影響成個計劃。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 go3 kyut3 ding6 ho2 nang4 wui5 jing2 hoeng2 sing4 go3 gai3 waak6
